input: actual raw 32-bit a0 word; A66/A68 second getter-read value
ordering: signed BLT thresholds16/12/38; BEQ/BNE equality and C.BNEZ zero gate
return: common epilogue moves a5 to RV32 a0
effects: 16-byte local frame; only s0 stack save/restore; no callee or external memory access
